_comment: Entities of a Home Assistant device -> device kind (data/device_kinds.json). Each entity is a signature: its domain ('switch') or domain.device_class ('cover.gate', the class chosen by the user first, then the integration's); config and diagnostic entities are never read (ha_registry). A key without a dot matches every entity of that domain. The FIRST tier with a matching signature decides, and inside it the first key in the order of the file: an actuator beats its sensors (a shutter with a temperature sensor is a shutter, a plug with power sensors is a plug), the sensors of a function beat the sensors of the room, power alone says a meter. Signatures not listed (battery, signal_strength, button, number, update...) never decide. weight: declared = W_DECLARED (a declared fact, above a word of the name), service = W_SERVICE, word = W_WORD (weak: a word of the name says more). finer: kinds of the same function that a word of the device may name more precisely (a climate entity on an air conditioner); the finer kind with the most word points takes the points. No brand here: only the standard domains and device classes of Home Assistant.
